rateType: Preferred Agent NETT rates (already Sunworld's discounted rate - no separate public Rack card found in this folder)

reducedRate_6nightsSpecialOffer_combined.confidenceNote: Rate shown is for the combined 'Porini Amboseli Camp & Porini Rhino Camp' offer column - applies when booking 6+ nights across 2 qualifying camps, min 3 nights each. See top-level offer terms.

roomNote: Each tent has 1 double bed + 1 single bed (3 adults possible; 3rd adult pays same per-person-sharing rate). 1 Family Unit (2 ensuite tents + interconnecting lounge, sold as 2 individual tents); a child taking a tent in the family unit pays 75% of per-person-sharing rate.
minStay: 2 nights (exclusive use also requires minimum 2 nights)
includes: Soft drinks, Tusker beer, house wine, vodka, gin & tonic, mineral water
Day & night shared game drives (open-sided 4x4, qualified guides)
Game drives in Selenkay Conservancy + one full day with picnic lunch in Amboseli National Park (2-3 night stays)
Free inter-camp transfers to Porini Cottages/Giraffe/Mara/Cheetah/Lion with enroute game drives
excludes: Exclusive use of vehicle: US$300/vehicle/day, min 2 days
Late departure after 10:00 checkout: US$125pp min 2 pax
Christmas/New Year supplement 24/25/26/31 Dec & 1 Jan: US$40pp/night

additionalFees.poriniWildlifeHabitatTrustPayment: US$5 per person per night, non-commissionable

airstripTransfers.raw: Selenkay Airstrip (charter flights, free) or Amboseli Airstrip (scheduled flights, +US$50pp pickup supplement + 1 park fee)

childPolicy.raw: 8-16 years sharing with 2 adults: 60% of adult rate.

specialOffers: 20 Dec-2 Jan booking of 8+ nights combining Porini Camps: 15% discount on total booking cost
Honeymoon: 50% off for bride staying 4+ nights (25% off in Aug/Sep), proof of wedding required, not combinable
Solo travelers: stay in single tent at no extra cost, valid 1 Nov-19 Dec and 2 Jan-31 May
Pay Stay: stay 4 nights pay for 3 (4th night free, conservancy fee still payable), valid year-round except Jul/Aug/Sep, 4 consecutive nights same camp

policies.deposit: 25% deposit to confirm, balance due 60 days before arrival
